_meta_itemized.page_gates: NO GRAIN AMBIGUITY ON THIS FILING: the cover is single-column (contrib current_report $1,480.52, last_report and cumulative_totals both EMPTY), so the cover figure and the period figure are the same number and the ledger cannot be period-vs-cumulative ambiguous. p2 (ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT) prints NO section total of its own - the 2020 single_total form carries the contribution total only on the cover - so that side is gated by the cover's $1,480.52, which the one row reproduces to the cent. p3 (ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT) carries TWO printed gates of its own, a boxed 'Total amount of expenditures $1,480.52' above the table and a 'TOTAL $1,480.52' in the last table row; 598.00 + 203.42 + 679.10 = 1,480.52 closes on both and on the cover. Row-count gate: rowbands found 44 bands on p2 (bands 1-2 title, band 4 header, band 5 the single data row, 39 blank ruled rows) and 35 on p3 (band 1 instruction line, band 2 header, bands 3-5 data, band 6 the TOTAL line, the rest blank) - both match what was read. _meta_itemized.notes: Stephanie Larsen, County Assessor, 2020 Pre-Election. Typed sheets with a poor-but-legible county OCR layer (the draft renders the title as 'Campaign Finacial Report' - which is the FORM's own printed typo, reproduced here as a source property, not an OCR artifact: the page really does read 'Finacial'). A wholly self-funded campaign spent to the cent: one contribution from the candidate herself of $1,480.52 dated 3/13/20, the same day as the $598.00 Summit County filing fee, and a $0.00 closing balance. The 2020 form's contribution sheet prints 'Mailing Address' + 'Zipcode' and NO city/state columns (the same property another agent recorded on 12943 Stevens); here the filer's address string itself ends in a place name, 'PO Box 668 Coalville', so donor_city is taken VERBATIM from what is printed inside that cell and the PO box is discarded at read time. donor_state is left BLANK - no state is printed anywhere on the row and it is not inferred from the 84017 zip. A handwritten filer annotation '(Invoices sent in June)' is written across the Purpose column of the Zazzle and Richards Signs rows in pen; it is an explanatory marginal note, not a fourth transaction, and neither the boxed total nor the TOTAL row changes for it. The Zazzle expense is dated 1/2/20, before the 3/13/20 declaration of candidacy - well-formed and kept verbatim. No specimen rows survive on this filing, no in-kind schedule, no redactions, no struck values.
